title: The 1963 OAU charter lists sovereign equality and non-interference as principles
summary: The 1963 OAU charter states sovereign equality and non-interference as principles.
body: The OAU charter, as Fordham prints it, lists among its principles the sovereign equality of all member states and non-interference in the internal affairs of states. The charter is the organization's text. It is not a record that every member observed the principles. The wording on the page includes: "II, solemnly affirm and declare their adherence to the following principles: 1. the sovereign equality of all Member States; 2. non-interference in the internal affairs of States; 3. respect for the sovereignty and territorial integrity of each State and for its inalienable right to independent existence; 4. peaceful settlement of disputes by negotiation, mediation, conciliation". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
